correctness.rationale: The proof directly reconstructs the invertible-matrix/evolution-algebra equivalence, obtains the exact transposition centralizer \(2^{2n-3}|\operatorname{GL}_{n-2}(\mathbb F_2)|\), derives \(d_\sigma=\sum_{i,j}\gcd(\ell_i,\ell_j)\) from ordered-pair orbit invariants, and proves both codimension bounds \(d_\sigma\le n^2-2r(n-r)\) and \(d_\sigma\le n(n-r)\). A two-range uniform summation over all permutations with deficiency r>=2 controls the total probability to \(O(n^4 2^{-3n})\); pair intersections and Burnside give the rare-symmetry and orbit count laws. Direct independent enumeration of all GL_n(F2) matrices \(n\le4\) checks fixed counts and orbits, but infinite asymptotics do not depend on these tests.
